zh.title: 墨爾本機場空中巴士A380航班數增32%
zh.summary: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，墨爾本機場空中巴士 A380 航班量將增加 32%。在 11 月至 3 月期間，墨爾本機場預計增加 109 個 A380 起飛航班，主因為有航空公司重新導入重型廣體客機運力。歷史紀錄顯示，澳洲航空先前曾規劃於 10 月 24 日結束墨爾本至洛杉磯的 A380 航線並改用波音 787-9。
body: 根據媒體 Simple Flying 報導，澳大利亞墨爾本機場的空中巴士 A380 超大型客機營運活動近期出現顯著增長，其 A380 航班總量獲得 32% 的大幅調升。
在今年 11 月至次年 3 月的營運期間內，墨爾本機場預計將增加 109 個空中巴士 A380 巨型客機的起飛航班。根據報導資訊，該項航班增長主要源於有一家航空公司選擇重新導入重型廣體客機的運力。
根據過往的本站歷史紀錄，澳洲航空先前曾規劃於 10 月 24 日執行其從墨爾本飛往洛杉磯的最後一班空中巴士 A380 航班，並在該航線上選擇改為使用波音 787-9 機型營運。

en.title: Melbourne Airport Sees 32% Increase in Airbus A380 Flights
en.summary: According to a report by Simple Flying, Melbourne Airport is experiencing a 32% increase in Airbus A380 flights. The Australian airport will handle 109 extra superjumbo departures scheduled between November and March. This spike in superjumbo flight activity occurs as one carrier reintroduces heavy widebody aircraft capacity. Meanwhile, historical records note that Qantas previously scheduled its final Airbus A380 service between Melbourne and Los Angeles for October 24, choosing to utilize the Boeing 787-9 widebody aircraft instead.
body: Melbourne Airport is recording a 32% increase in Airbus A380 flights, according to a report by Simple Flying. The surge in superjumbo activity marks a notable expansion in heavy widebody capacity at the Australian airport.

Between November and March, Melbourne Airport is scheduled to gain 109 additional Airbus A380 departures. This rise in flights comes as one carrier reintroduces heavy widebody aircraft capacity to its operations.

In related historical context, Qantas previously scheduled its final Airbus A380 flight from Melbourne to Los Angeles for October 24, with the Australian airline opting to utilize the Boeing 787-9 aircraft for the route instead.
